purpose: 대형 해적선 모델링 스타일 선택용 콘셉트 샘플. Blender 모델의 실제 렌더가 아닙니다.

variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: single concept image for choosing a Blender 3D modeling art direction.
Primary request: one magnificent large pirate galleon with medieval fantasy appeal; an original design, not a recognizable franchise ship.
Shared ship brief: approximately 55 meter wooden hull, three tall masts, two rows of broadside gunports, stepped raised sterncastle with captain's windows, long bowsprit, spacious working deck, coherent sails, rigging, railings, cannons, anchors and a carved figurehead. It must read as a large seaworthy sailing ship.
Composition: one complete ship only, landscape 3:2 frame. Slightly elevated front three-quarter view, bow pointing to lower left, stern toward upper right. Show the long broadside and some deck. Entire bowsprit, mast tips, sails and stern fully in frame with generous margins. Fill most of the frame. Simple calm sea with a low horizon and restrained overcast sky; minimal background distraction. Same approximate framing and scale as a matched style-comparison set.
Construction: coherent mast and yard attachments, sensible taut rigging, wind-filled sails all responding to the same wind, clearly readable structure useful to a 3D modeler. The aft mast has a triangular lateen sail. No steam engines or modern technology.
Avoid: collage, multiple panels, extra ships, people as main subjects, text, labels, borders, watermarks, branded designs, cropped mast tips, obscuring fog.
Art direction: DARK FANTASY. A powerful ominous pirate flagship, weathered almost-black timber, charcoal-black canvas sails with a few worn edges and patches, heavy dark ironwork, restrained aged brass carvings and warm amber stern lanterns. Stern resembles a compact timber fortress, elegant threatening silhouette, subtly skull-like carved figurehead. Grounded physically plausible fantasy craftsmanship, richly detailed realistic 3D concept render. Soft cool daylight with enough fill to clearly see wood planks and all hull construction. Moderate contrast, no pitch-black hidden surfaces, no supernatural effects, no excessive spikes, no glowing runes. Convey formidable mass and age.

Art direction: STYLIZED PREMIUM GAME ART. Large heroic pirate galleon rendered as a polished stylized 3D game asset. Exaggerated sweeping bow, broad sturdy hull, expressive tall curved stern, chunky beveled timber planks, simplified readable rigging, pleasantly billowing cream sails, oversized sturdy cannon forms and bold carved figurehead. Warm rich wood tones, simplified painted surface shading, controlled hand-painted texture accents, clear shapes and clean edge highlights. Strong silhouette readable at small scale. Soft bright daylight and gentle ambient shadows. Craftsmanship on the level of a finished high-quality game asset, not a toy, not low-detail blockout, not photorealistic, no extreme faceting. Keep it unmistakably a very large three-masted warlike sailing ship.
variants.final_edit_prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Edit target: the attached large pirate galleon concept image.
Create the DEFINITIVE STYLIZED option for comparison against two realistic ship concepts. This must be visibly different at first glance.
Keep: a single large three-masted pirate galleon, bow on the left and stern on the right, two gunport rows, raised stern, cream sails, long bowsprit, broadside three-quarter view.
CHANGE THE ENTIRE ART STYLE AND GEOMETRY to a distinctly stylized cartoon 3D game asset with strongly exaggerated chunky proportions, thick curved planks, very large simplified cannon barrels, broad sweeping hull, an expressive squat sterncastle, big billowing simple sails, rope ladders with clearly separated oversized rungs, spars and rails with chunky rounded bevels. Omit most small rigging and decorative filigree. Simplify the lion figurehead into a bold readable sculpture.
Use smooth painterly color gradients, broad clean color areas, soft ambient occlusion, hand-painted edge highlights, warm ochre wood, cream canvas, dark blue trim. No realistic wood grain or stains, no microscopic surfaces, no photographic lighting, no photoreal ocean, no intricate realism. The visual language should be obviously feature-animation-inspired and hand-painted game art, with readable shapes even at thumbnail size.
Background: simple illustrated pale blue sky with a few soft clouds and stylized teal waves. Clean bright daylight.
Frame wider than the reference so every mast tip and flag is visible inside the image with generous top margin. Landscape 3:2. One ship, one image. No text, labels, borders or watermarks.
